cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a visible, friendly height with the gripper pointing upwards (setup), then performs a rhythmic side-to-side wrist movement to wave (core action), concluding by smoothly lowering the arm (follow-through).

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm smoothly rises from a neutral position to a greeting height, offers a subtle acknowledgement with a wrist flick, then gracefully lowers to a relaxed posture.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot moves into a slightly forward-leaning posture to signal anticipation (setup), then smoothly bows forward and downward from the 'waist' (shoulder) in a gesture of respect or greeting, holding briefly (core action), before slowly and gracefully returning to an upright, composed position (follow-through).

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot's arm lifts to a ready position, smoothly extends forward, rotates its gripper to a vertical orientation suitable for a handshake, holds briefly, and then gently retracts and settles.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm to a handshake position, performs a vertical up-and-down shaking motion with the wrist, and then retracts to a relaxed posture.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position to embrace its own 'body' (simulating a hug) by sweeping inward and across its chest, holds for a moment of comfort, then slowly relaxes back to a neutral, slightly forward posture.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot raises its arm and brings its hand to its lips, then performs a short, gentle forward movement to simulate blowing a kiss, before settling its arm.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot's arm moves from a neutral position, smoothly rises above its head to form the bottom point of a heart, then gracefully sweeps upward and outward to form one lobe, followed by sweeping downward and inward to complete the other lobe, signifying love or affection. The motion concludes with the arm settling back down.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot positions its arm, then gently brings its hand to rest over its chest, holding it there with a soft gesture to convey sincerity or gratitude, before slowly withdrawing.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot pulls its arm slightly inward in anticipation (setup), then executes a powerful, coordinated upward thrust to signal victory (core action), holding briefly with a small celebratory shake, before smoothly lowering the arm into a relaxed, proud posture (follow-through).

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm prepares with a slight upward and inward motion (setup), executes a forceful downward fist pump with a quick rebound (core action), and then smoothly settles into a proud, slightly lowered position (follow-through).

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves slightly forward as if preparing, then rapidly flexes its elbow to 'show' a bicep, holds the pose to convey strength, and slowly lowers the arm.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot arm moves to a 'ready to nod' position (setup), performs two distinct nodding gestures with varying intensity (core action), then slowly settles into a relaxed position (follow-through).

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot raises its arm to a head-level position, sweeps the gripper to one side, then shakes it rapidly side to side to signify 'no', before slowly returning to a neutral posture.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot expresses uncertainty by lifting its arm and rotating its gripper to an 'open palms' posture, holding briefly, then relaxing.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its arm to the right side of its head, performs a small, light lateral scratching motion near the temple, then slowly lowers its arm, conveying confusion or contemplation.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot's 'head' (gripper) makes a subtle forward and lateral shift, then performs a delicate tilt to one side, holding for a moment to convey curiosity, before gently easing back to a slightly more upright position.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot expresses frustration by slowly raising its arm, bringing its hand to cover its face, holding the pose, and then slowly lowering its arm in resignation.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly forward in a ready stance, then draws its hand sharply towards its own chest, positioning the gripper tip to point inwards, as if to say 'me' or 'I'. The gesture concludes with a slight, relaxed retraction.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm and points forward to indicate direction or address someone, with a clear and deliberate motion.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly down, turns its gripper to simulate a palm-down orientation, then performs a rapid, repetitive curling motion of the gripper (fingers) to beckon, finishing with a graceful withdrawal.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm performs a decisive 'stop' gesture by raising slightly, extending its arm forward with a flat palm, holding the pose, and then slightly retracting.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot starts in a thoughtful neutral-forward pose, then executes a subtle preparatory movement. It then performs a smooth, deliberate upward lift, simultaneously rotating its gripper to point vertically, holding this 'one moment' gesture to emphasize an important point, before a gentle settling follow-through.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot's arm rises and extends forward as if preparing to make a 'shh' gesture, then precisely touches its gripper (representing a finger) to its lips, holds the pose, and finally retracts the arm to a composed position.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot positions its arm to the side of the stomach, performs two gentle patting motions to convey a feeling of hunger or contented fullness, then smoothly withdraws.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot's arm pulls inward, then reaches across its body to simulate rubbing its opposite upper arm or chest for warmth. It performs a rapid, repetitive horizontal rubbing motion, concluding by settling into a slightly more huddled, drawn-in posture.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises its arm and brings its hand near its face, then performs rapid fanning motions to simulate cooling down, followed by a slower fanning and a final forehead wipe, indicating discomfort from heat or exertion.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot's arm slowly rises and moves towards its face, simulating the 'opening mouth' part of a yawn. It then smoothly brings the hand to cover the 'mouth' area, holds the pose for a moment, and slowly withdraws and settles back down.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot arm lifts and positions near its left eye, gently performs a rubbing motion, then slowly withdraws, conveying fatigue.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot arm moves to a respectful 'hands at sides' posture, then executes a deep, continuous bowing motion, holding briefly at the lowest point to convey solemnity, and finally returns to an upright, composed stance.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot lifts its arm to a mid-front position, performs two rapid wrist 'flexes' to signify air quotes, then smoothly lowers its arm.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, precisely approaches the temple, performs a series of rapid tapping motions, then gently withdraws and holds a contemplative pose.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot positions its gripper near the left temple, then traces several concentric circles to signal 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard', before settling back.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot brings its gripper to its mouth as if to make contact, then slides it horizontally across the lips, finishing with a small upward flick to simulate 'zipping' the mouth shut, indicating a secret or refusal to speak.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot starts with an arm slightly forward and to the side, then smoothly sweeps it across its chest, bending the elbow so the hand rests on the opposite side of the chest, creating a defensive, closed posture.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position, lifts slightly, and then sweeps laterally and downwards to place its gripper (representing a hand) firmly on its hip, adjusting its orientation to signal confidence or annoyance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot expresses interest by leaning its body slightly forward, extending an arm, and presenting its gripper (palms open) in a receptive posture, holding it briefly.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot recoils slightly from a neutral position as if startled (setup), then rapidly raises its arm with palm facing forward (core action), holding the shocked expression before a subtle settling (follow-through).

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot leans slightly forward as if engaged, then recoils sharply backward and upward in surprise, bringing its hand rapidly to cover its mouth with its palm, holding briefly in a 'gasp' or 'oops' gesture, and finally slowly regaining composure by lowering the hand and settling back.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper to a central, slightly elevated position as if pressing palms, then performs a smooth, respectful bow by lowering the arm from the shoulder, holding briefly, and finally returning to a composed position.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot arm moves into a position as if holding a glass, smoothly raises it for a 'cheers' gesture, holds briefly, and then gently lowers it.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot positions its arm forward in a ready stance, smoothly extends it forward and slightly upward, simultaneously rotating its wrist to present an open palm upwards as an invitation for a high five, then gently retracts to a settled position.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm to a 'ready' position with the palm facing forward, pulls back slightly in anticipation, then executes a swift and powerful downward swing as if high-fiving an imaginary target, followed by a quick recoil and a relaxed settle.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot lifts its arm from a relaxed position, smoothly extends it forward with the gripper angled as if offering a fist bump, holds, then slightly retracts.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its gripper like a fist in front of its body, performs a light tapping motion as if against an imaginary palm, then gently retracts and settles.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot arm lifts and rotates to reach behind its body towards its upper back (setup). It then executes two gentle patting motions with the wrist (core action), before smoothly withdrawing and settling into a slightly relaxed posture (follow-through), conveying self-encouragement or a job well done.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot positions its arm in front of its body, then uses its wrist to trace two continuous circles in a vertical plane, simulating drawing. It concludes by retracting and settling its arm.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot positions a flat, horizontal hand near the right side of its throat, then performs a swift, sharp horizontal slicing motion across the throat area, concluding with a firm, decisive posture.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot positions its hand under its chin with the back of the fingers facing outward, then performs a rapid, dismissive swipe forward and slightly away from the body, concluding with a settling motion.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot arm moves into a forward, lowered position as if over a table, performs a drumming motion with the wrist, starting fast and slowing, then subtly withdraws, indicating impatience or boredom.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm forward, rotates its wrist to present an upward-facing palm, and then makes a small, gentle 'come here' motion by pulling the hand back slightly, concluding with a soft retraction.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral-forward position, then executes a smooth, steady upward extension, subtly opening its palm as if presenting something. It holds this offering gesture briefly before settling slightly.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot's arm prepares from a low, slightly forward position, then rapidly raises to the side of its head in a gesture of surrender or exasperation, holds briefly with a slight tremor, and finally settles into a slightly lowered, resigned posture.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot's arm moves to the side of its head, as if covering an ear, indicating a refusal to listen or discomfort from noise, then slowly withdraws.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot arm begins from a neutral central position, then deliberately expands outwards with a broad, inviting arc. It reaches a wide, open posture, holds briefly to convey welcome, and then gently settles back while maintaining an open, approachable stance.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot arm lifts from a neutral position, sweeps upward into a full, extended stretch, holds briefly, and then slowly lowers and relaxes, conveying a sense of relief or stretching.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot's arm moves from a relaxed position, lifts and bends at the elbow to bring the gripper to the forehead, holds briefly in a saluting gesture, and then lowers.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot lifts its arm to forehead level, positions its hand as a visor, holds this pose while performing a subtle lateral scan, and then slowly lowers its arm, conveying a sense of searching or looking into the distance.
